title: Health columns: CI, security, housekeeping
goal: Columns 9, 12 and 14 read GitHub and report unknown when it cannot be read
acceptance: Column 9: last full CI run age, reruns and flaky tests in the last N runs (N a setting, default 20), and each scheduled workflow's last run against its schedule
Column 12: open code-scanning alerts, Dependabot or security alerts and open Dependabot PRs; a token or scope that cannot read them reads unknown, never zero
Column 14: merged branches still on the remote
GitHub is read through one injectable client (as the existing remote reading is), so fixtures replay recorded invented responses; offline reads unknown
Fixtures, committed failing first: a stale scheduled workflow, a flaky rerun, an unreadable alert API reported unknown, a merged branch left behind
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories, manifests and API responses; no personal data, no real alert content.
escalation: A change to how an existing table, gap kind or evidence file behaves goes back to the owner
A source that cannot be read without a new token scope or a project edit is reported unknown, never worked around

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one client seam and three readers; the schedule-versus-last-run rule is the new logic. Not a measurement.
